quests.title: The Errand

beats.description: Deliver Erin's package to Selys at the Adventurer's Guild.
Decide what to do with Selys's reward, there at the Guild.

quests._resolution_order: FORK-EXCLUSIVE, so the order is inert -- both rungs are options of the SAME node (selys_delivery's delivered/delivered_smooth) and each hide_when's on the errand_decided both of them bank, so a second rung can never land.

resolution_paths.text: You kept the coin as your own courier's fee.
You sent the reward back to Erin.

quests.title: The Missing Crate

beats.description: Find out what happened to Krshia's missing crate near the south-square sewers.
Tell Krshia what became of her crate, at her market stall on Market Street.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). Three independent surfaces bank these -- the street fight, watch_crate, and Krshia's guile read, which hides only on crate_returned and so stays offered after a fight -- so they co-bank freely. Ladder: force > watch > guile.

resolution_paths.text: You found the truth of it yourself, no fight needed.
You sent the Watch after them.
You cleared the scavengers by force.

quests._comment: heard_about_cisterns (the grate-gate + quest-start) is NOT a beat; it only opens the door.
quests.title: Something in the Cisterns

beats.description: Settle the nest Olesm marked in the cisterns beneath the market — however you see fit.
beats.hint: The way down is the sewer grate off the south square; the cisterns open off the sewers.

beats.description: Report the outcome to Olesm at the Guild.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). All three counters can co-bank -- scout the ledge, then still clear the nest -- and the STRONGER claim must be what the journal records: cleared > swept > scouted.

resolution_paths.text: You scouted it and reported the intelligence.
You sent the Watch to sweep it.
You cleared the nest yourself.

quests._comment: Quest 2 'The Wrong Order' (Lyonette, social).
quests.title: The Wrong Order

beats.description: Set Lyonette's botched supply order right — strong-arm the supplier on Market Street, sweet-talk Krshia at her stall, or stretch it in the inn kitchen.
Tell Lyonette it's handled, in the inn common room, before Erin hears of it.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). Same co-bank class as missing_crate: the short_order pot is ungated and supplier_scavengers carries no encounter_when, so cooking and fighting are both still available after either. Ladder: strongarmed > smoothed > stretched.

resolution_paths.text: You stretched the order yourself, in the kitchen.
You smoothed it over with Krshia.
You strong-armed the supplier.

quests._comment: GH#167: the Raskghar arc finally gets a journal quest -- the MAIN story spine was the only thread without one, so its direction lived in a transient toast and once-per-waking relay lines. Started in CODE at the same sleep that fires the runner pointer (_maybe_fire_tremor_pointer), with a load-time backfill for mid-arc saves (save.gd).
quests.title: Something Beneath

beats.description: A Watch runner was asking for you. Find Captain Zevara at the Liscor gate.
Zevara wants eyes on the fissure below the dungeon gallery — down through the approach, into the deep tunnels. Find what's making the tremor.
You came back up. Tell Zevara, at the gate — she counts heads.

resolution_paths.text: You brought the tremor's answer back up to Zevara, and she wrote the warren down as closed.

quests._comment: Spec 3, the backport. SPOILER RULE: title + join_dig/breach copy never mention a door; the reveal is the haul beat. Beats are ORDER-GATED by their counters' own gating (camp on horns_dig_joined, pedestal on camp, haul on pedestal) -- do not accept the catalyst-style cosmetic skip here.
quests.title: The Dig

beats.description: Ceria's expedition hit something sealed under the ruin east past the gate road, across the floodplains, and they're short-handed. Find the Horns' camp at the ruin.
Get the Horns through the ruin's sealed pedestal level — fight what guards it, walk the plates, or read the wardwork.
Help the Horns carry what the pedestal held back to the Wandering Inn, and see it mounted.

resolution_paths.text: You dug beside the Horns for what the pedestal held, and carried it home to hang in the inn.

quests._comment: Reshape (spec 2.5): the door works to Liscor from mounting (horns_dig haul); this chain is the first FAR attunement. door_awakened re-semantics to 'reaches beyond Liscor'. Auto-starts at door_mounted via the mounting conversation (no start option). 3 beats, catalyst still ungated on consult by design.
quests.title: The Door That Goes Elsewhere

beats.description: The Magical Door manages the hop to Liscor but strains at anything farther. Fight what leaks through in the cellar, ask Pisces by the Guild steps, or read the wardwork yourself.
beats.hint: Pisces keeps to the Guild steps on Market Street — asking him is the plainest of the three.

beats.description: Buy the attunement catalyst from Krshia's stall on Market Street in Liscor.

beats._comment: GH#334 ruling 15: errand/wait split. H3: door_awakened closes it too.
beats.description: Bring Krshia's catalyst and the anchor stone to Pisces, by the Guild steps on Market Street.
Sleep at the inn while the Door learns the stone — it takes more than one night.
beats.hint: Take a bed at the inn and sleep. The Door goes on working at the stone while you rest.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). Reading the wardwork and fighting the leak co-bank freely, and the STRONGER claim must win: fought > read. The ""-req consult entry is the FALLBACK, not a path -- it answers only when neither counter banked, and its trailing position is convention, not mechanism.

resolution_paths.text: You read the wardwork yourself.
You fought the rift vermin in the cellar.
You consulted Pisces about it.

quests._comment: Three-path parity mirroring the cisterns/wrong_order two-beat shape.
quests.title: The Price of a Favor

beats.description: Settle the debt collecting on Riverfarm — the witch in the hollow west of the fields is the one collecting it. Drive her off, broker fair terms, or pay it yourself.
Tell the headman, at the village longhouse-side square, it's done.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins), and this array ALREADY reads correctly -- left as authored. The briar collectors and Eloise's mediation can co-bank, and the brokered terms are the stronger claim there: driving them off only clears the field, the renegotiated year is what actually lifts the blight. Ladder: mediated > drove_off. The ""-req entry is the FALLBACK (paid it yourself at the stones), not a rung.

resolution_paths.text: You drove off the collectors by force.
You brokered fair terms with the witch.
You paid the debt yourself, at the standing stones.

quests._comment: v0.16 #305 R1. Beat 1 is complete_when_any over the three route counters (cisterns idiom): the HELP route banks through on_skill_use, which banks exactly ONE counter (wi_game.gd:480), so no shared resolve counter can cover all three -- the headman carries one REPORT option per route instead.
quests.title: The Flood Ledger

beats.description: The mill's grain tally is short and the village is quietly accusing itself. Walk the tally at the mill by the river, work the flood prep there, or clear whatever has been living in the granary corner.
Bring the headman an answer he can live with, at the village square.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins) and all three co-bank -- clear the granary, then still walk the tally. Ladder: read > worked > cleared. Driving vermin out of the corner explains eleven bushels of spoilage; standing in the shed until the count can be SEEN is better; naming the failed crop without naming the household is the answer the headman actually needed.

resolution_paths.text: You cleared the granary corner, and the shortfall stopped growing.
You worked the flood prep at the mill until the count came right in the doing.
You walked the tally and found a failed crop where the village had looked for a thief.

quests._comment: v0.16 #305 R2. SKILL route banks ward_scrap_read ONLY, never detected_wardwork (trapped_halls.json:355 protects its >=3 threshold). RETIRED FOR NEW SAVES 2026-08-05 (#396); successor a_winter_of_teeth.
quests.title: What the Thicket Keeps

beats.description: The corusdeer herd stops dead at a line in the thicket it will not cross. Walk the line with the shepherd and shift the fences off the herd's road, read the old boundary work in the hut at the hollow, or clear whatever has denned on the line.
Tell the shepherd what the thicket is keeping, back at his post in Riverfarm village.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins) and all three co-bank -- kill the den, then still read the ward. Ladder: read > rerouted > cleared. Killing the predator moves one animal off a line that was never about the predator; moving the fences is the humble, correct answer; reading the boundary is the only one that explains why the line is there at all.

resolution_paths.text: You cleared the den off the line and let the herd try again.
You moved the fences instead of the deer, and the herd kept its road.
You read the old boundary work and learned what the thicket has been keeping out.

quests._comment: #396. Replaces what_the_thicket_keeps for NEW saves; the legacy def above stays completable forever. FIGHT counter is survived_wolf_night (FROZEN, identical semantics, encounter untouched).
quests.title: A Winter of Teeth

beats.description: Wolf sign thickens toward the hollow and the shepherd is losing lambs. Stand the night watch at the field edge, rebuild the fold from the stacked hurdles, or walk the wolf sign and learn what pushed the pack.
Tell the shepherd how the winter gets survived, at the lamb pen.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins), all three co-bank. Ladder: traced > fold > watch. One night's wolves buy a night; hurdles buy a winter; knowing why they push is the answer. PRE-BANK COHORT: a new save can win river_wolf_pack before ever talking, so the hub carries a survived_wolf_night text_variant and the offer row stays normal -- accept-then-resolve reads intentional rather than as the New-quest/Quest-complete defect. All three report rows carry heard_winter_teeth beside their route counter so no ungated producer can leak winter_answered.

resolution_paths.text: You stood the night watch and the pack paid for the field.
You rebuilt the fold, and the wolves stopped mattering.
You walked the sign back and found the pack was pushed — their old ground is held by something on the line.

quests._comment: v0.16 P1 (#307). complete_when_any is an OR beside complete_when (quests.gd:28-38). The FIGHT counter is golem_recalibrated, never forge_golems_culled, so this quest cannot feed bounty_forge_golem_cull.
quests.title: Tempered Standards

beats.description: Take the smith's commission through to an answer, in the forge hall past her second bench.
Bring the smith the answer at her anvil, and let her file it.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). All three co-bank -- a player can fight the rig, run a billet AND read the notice in one visit -- so the STRONGER claim must be what the journal records. Ladder: brokered > temper > rig. Putting the rig down fixes an instrument; running one temper right proves the apprentice's work; brokering ends the six-year disagreement that made the work fail in the first place, which is the only outcome that survives the player leaving the tier.

resolution_paths.text: You put the drifting calibration rig back inside its own tolerance.
You ran the temper yourself, and the billet came back.
You proved the smith and the examiner had agreed all along, and got it in writing.

quests._comment: v0.16 P2 (#307). Giver is on pallass_forge and every route resolves on pallass_den_shop, so the unstick beat must name the den shop (the travel-landmark check arms when no producer map is the giver map).
quests.title: The Ledger Eats First

beats.description: Get the held crate to its consignee at the den shop on the market tier — by the offices, by the forms, or on your own back.
Tell the lift attendant at the forge-tier landing that his manifest is clean.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). All three co-bank -- nothing stops a player carrying the crate AND walking the offices AND reading the forms. Ladder: exemption > loop > carry. Carrying it moves one crate and leaves the loop exactly as it was; walking the offices produces a countersignature that works ONCE; finding the exemption fixes the rule itself, so the next crate never enters the queue at all.

resolution_paths.text: You carried the crate down two tiers yourself and put it on her dock.
You walked the offices in order and made the queue countersign itself.
You found the exemption that had been on the paper the whole time.

quests._comment: Three-path parity mirroring the cisterns/wrong_order/price_of_a_favor two-beat shape.
quests.title: A Gentleman's Disagreement

beats.description: Find out exactly where Coyle's operation actually runs, along the boulevard, before you make a move on him.
Clear Farley's name — corner Master Coyle, back on the boulevard, however you see fit.
Tell Wilovan it's done, at the Brothers' parlor off the alleys.

quests._resolution_paths_comment: The 3 info-gathering methods (STEALTH/TALK/FIGHT) feed the SAME resolve beat regardless of which fork is chosen, so they aren't separately surfaced here.
quests._resolution_order: FORK-EXCLUSIVE, so the order is inert -- both rungs are options of `cornered`, whose only two entrances (the hub row and the accusation row) each hide_when on the merchant_fate_decided both rungs bank, so the node cannot be re-reached after a choice.

resolution_paths.text: You exposed Coyle publicly.
You extorted Coyle for gold.

quests._comment: v0.16 I1 (#306). Giver is the stationer client (ruling 1). `resolve` is a travel beat (producers on mercantile_alleys, giver on stationer) so it names the alleys; `report` produces on the giver's own map.
quests.title: A Setting for a Lady

beats.description: Hedault keeps a bench in the alleys and will not set the stone until somebody says the true thing about it. Tell him, read the ward at his bench, or find out who took the original.
Go back to the Lady with the ring box and tell her how it ended.

quests._resolution_order: Weakest claim first (src/core/quests.gd:82-87); LAST MATCH WINS among real rungs, so a completionist reads as the strongest deed: setting_assisted (you helped) < heirloom_truth_kept (you brokered the truth) < original_recovered (you brought back the real stone). No ""-fallback rung -- the handover option is gated on holding at least one route counter, so setting_commissioned cannot bank without one.

resolution_paths.text: You stood at Hedault's bench and read the ward-line with him. He did not correct you, which from him is a reference.
You said the true thing about the stone out loud so she would never have to, and the setting was made honest around it.
Forty years after somebody swapped it, you took the original back off a Fence's shelf and put it in her hands.

quests._comment: v0.16 I2 (#306). Giver is Wilovan in the parlor; all three route counters produce on adventurers_rest, so `run` is a travel beat naming the Rest (LANDMARK_TOKENS `adventurer`). `{addr}` is FORBIDDEN here -- quests.json is scanned as unresolvable.
quests.title: The Hat Stays On

beats.description: The handover happens at the Adventurer's Rest, where nobody raises a voice. Talk it round, move it without a word, or find out what happens when it goes loud.
Go back to the parlor and tell Wilovan how the evening went.

quests._resolution_order: Weakest claim first, LAST MATCH WINS: handoff_loud (it went wrong, you finished it) < handoff_talked (you talked it round) < handoff_quiet (nobody in the room ever knew). The loud ending is the job done badly and finished anyway; the quiet one is the gentleman's ideal, so it wins a completionist's read.

resolution_paths.text: The hat came off. The package still changed hands, and the house has agreed to remember it as a misunderstanding about a chair.
Three exchanges, no names, and a package that was never once mentioned by anybody at the table.
Hat on the third peg, coat over the chair, the wrong one taken on the way out. Nobody raised a voice and nobody raised an eye.

quests._comment: FOUR real stages, not the cisterns/wrong_order two-beat shape: this is a genuine dungeon, not a posting. Task 2.2 named cleared_halls_by_force on snare_nest_slot so the fight has an id of its own; four Act V fixtures carried halls_cleared with no route counter and gained it, keeping their recorded ending byte-identical.
quests.title: What the Seal Kept

beats.description: Reach the reopened gallery in the dungeon beneath Liscor and find Ceria Springwalker's team waiting.
Get the Horns of Hammerad through the trapped halls — fight, disarm the traps, or talk your way past.
Clear whatever the Horns are guarding against, deep past the trapped halls, and see what lies beyond it.
Tell Olesm what you found sealed behind the door, at the Guild.

quests._resolution_order: WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST (resolved_path is last-match-wins). Guiding Ksmvr and clearing the snare co-bank freely, and the fight is the stronger claim. The ""-req entry is the FALLBACK, and here it is a REAL ROUTE: the dart-slit disarm ([Observe] + a trap kit) banks only halls_cleared, so a player who never fought and never talked lands here. It used to hand that player melee_hit 12 / won_combat 2 and tell them they had cleared the halls themselves -- the pacifist mislabel spec A5 named. cleared_halls_by_force now discriminates the fight, so the fallback can say what the disarmer actually did.

resolution_paths.text: You guided Ksmvr through the pressure plates.
You cleared the trapped halls yourself.
You took the halls apart trap by trap, and nothing in them ever went off.

beats.description: Find Recruit Pell — last seen chasing a noise down in the sewers beneath the market — before the Watch has to call it something worse.
Walk Pell back to the barracks and tell Sergeant Ashgrave they're safe.

resolution_paths.text: You walked Pell back to the barracks yourself. Ashgrave logged it and said nothing else.

beats.description: Track down Renn's backup warhammer somewhere in the Guild hall — he swears he left it by the back wall.
Return the warhammer to Renn, at the Guild.

resolution_paths.text: You found Renn's hammer where he swore it could not be, and handed it back without saying so.

beats.description: Get Selys to sponsor your Pallass application, at the Guild.
Buy Krshia's attunement stone at her market stall so the Door can reach Pallass.
Present yourself to the stamp clerk on the market tier, just through the Door.

resolution_paths.text: Your papers cleared, stamped and filed in the proper order, and Pallass opened for them.

beats.description: File your permit application at the permit office by the Grand Lift, on Pallass's market tier.
Pass Grimalkin's fitness examination at the permit office by the Grand Lift.
Collect your stamped lift pass at the permit office window, back beside the Grand Lift.

resolution_paths.text: You passed Grimalkin's examination on your own legs, and the lift pass came back stamped.

quests.title: The Chieftain's Price

beats.description: Someone on the southern floodplains has been watching you. Find out who.
beats.hint: Walk the southern floodplains and speak to the scouting party you find out there.

beats._comment: GH#338: hint only -- the imperative re-cut of this description is deferred, see .lane-progress.
beats.description: Rags named her trade: medicine for her wounded, a carved piece in return.
beats.hint: Talk with Rags again, out with her scouting party on the southern floodplains.

beats.description: Settle the trade — supplies from your pack, goods brokered in Liscor, or refuse it outright.

quests._resolution_order: FORK-EXCLUSIVE, so the order is inert -- all three rungs hang off `settle` (the draught, the trade goods, and [Draw steel.] which starts rags_scouting_party), the hub row into it hide_when's on rags_meeting_settled, and every rung banks that counter (the encounter via its own on_victory). Steel also removes the entity outright.

resolution_paths.text: You handed over medicine from your own pack.
You stood the cost of quiet trade goods from Liscor.
You drew steel on a parley.

quests._comment: v0.16 F1 (#308). TRAP: the offer's hide_when on drove_off_rags is SINGLE-KEY -- hide_when is AND across keys and the betrayal win banks both terminals.
quests.title: The Price Kept

beats.description: Winter stores for the camp: broker a quiet run through Krshia's stall on Market Street, fill the hollow's larder beside the hunters, or hold its ground when the scavengers press.
Tell Rags it is done, out on the southern floodplains where she waits.

quests._resolution_order: LAST-MATCH-WINS (WIQuests.resolved_path), so the array is ordered WEAKEST CLAIM FIRST and escalates: brokered (you paid Liscor to move it) -> larder (you carried and hunted for it) -> ground (you stood in the line beside them). A player who did all three keeps the strongest claim, matching missing_crate's guile/watch/force ladder.

resolution_paths.text: You moved winter stores south on Silverfang carts, and nobody wrote down whose hands they went to.
You hunted and hauled with the camp's own, and the racks were full before the frost.
You stood in the line beside goblins, and the scavengers went elsewhere.

quests._comment: Spec 4: discovery-driven spine. Beats complete on lattice counters the REGIONS bank. Starts from Pisces at door_awakened. RULE AMENDED (GH#334 note 21): 'reach, never objects' PRODUCED the Invrisil bug. A beat names the ERRAND when the reach is gated on an object.
quests.title: Where the Door Reaches

beats.description: The Door reaches Riverfarm now. See what's out there.
Invrisil is where the Door wants to go next, and it will not go on its own. Eloise keeps travel-stones under the cloth in her hollow at Riverfarm. A city that size holds people worth knowing.
The Door reaches Pallass now. The Walled City does not open for just anyone.
Pisces has been collecting everything you've learned. Hear him out, by the Guild steps.

resolution_paths.text: You walked the Door's reach to three cities, and Pisces had all of it written down before you got back.

quests._resolution_order: resolution_paths resolve LAST-MATCH-WINS (WIQuests.resolved_path), mirroring sleep_veil.gd's FINALE_CLOSE_LINES so the recorded ending and the paid grant can never contradict the curtain's own line. Load-bearing HERE and nowhere else yet: seal_opened is a bounce hatch -- open the door, then still get it fed or re-warded -- and first-match paid the FIGHT grant for an ending the player talked or warded their way to. Order these three by escalation, weakest claim first.
quests._comment: Act V (#270 beats 1-3, as amended by spec 7). BEATS ARE ORDER-GATED: no beat's counter can bank before its predecessor's, so the catalyst-style cosmetic skip is impossible. descend banks ONLY at seal_kept_door with seal_descent_agreed held; read banks only once the runes are read; resolve has three producers, each behind the reading. SPOILER DISCIPLINE: 'feeding' appears in no beat copy until beat 3, which the journal only shows once the reading has revealed it on screen (WIQuests surfaces the ACTIVE beat alone). Landmarks: every beat names the trapped halls.
quests.title: What the Seal Was Feeding

beats.description: Take Pisces down past the trapped halls to the sealed rune-door, and let him read it in person.
The hand that cut it cut the inn's frame too. Find out what the seal is FOR, there at the door in the halls.
Settle it at the door in the trapped halls: open it, keep it fed, or re-cut the ward yourself.

resolution_paths.text: You broke the seal and walked into what it was feeding.
You got the Watch to keep it fed.
You re-cut the ward yourself, and paid for it in ruin-glass.

quests._comment: v0.18 W3 (#318) <!-- v018-W3 -->. Giver is the stationer client, behind her I1 terminal. `trace` produces on the giver's own map so it needs no landmark; `answer` and `report` are travel beats and name the alleys and the Rest. `{addr}` is FORBIDDEN here -- quests.json is scanned as unresolvable.
quests.title: The Name and the Habit

beats.description: Somebody is signing with her house's name. The scribe at this stationer's counter rents a blank seal by the hour, so start with him.
The hand that rented it keeps a table at the west end of the mercantile alleys. Buy the block back, lift it off him, or take it the other way.
A steward is waiting at the Adventurer's Rest for the answer to a card. Give it to her yourself.

quests._resolution_order: Weakest claim first, LAST MATCH WINS (src/core/quests.gd), the_hat_stays_on's ladder for this city, ranked by how much of the acquisition survives to be found: taken (half the street watched) < bought (a transaction to find) < handed over (no coin, no witness, only his memory) < lifted (nobody knew it moved). FOUR rungs for FOUR forks -- fix round 1 added block_handed_over, since the free [Charming Smile] arm banked block_bought_back and this line then told a player who spent nothing that they had bought the block. Order is authorial, not load-bearing (one counter can ever bank), but ordered so a fifth fork inherits the ladder. No ""-fallback rung -- beat 2 completes on seal_block_settled, which every route banks.

resolution_paths.text: You took the brass off his table with his two men on the paving beside it. Half that street watched, which is its own kind of answer.
You bought the block off him outright. He would have taken less, and both of you knew it, and neither of you said so.
He put the brass into your hand for nothing and asked you to call it destroyed. You did not call it destroyed, and that is the part of it he will remember.
The block left the table mid-sentence and he was still talking when you reached the tea shop. Nobody in the city knows it moved.

quests._comment: #396: wraps the [Hedge Witch] grant in a quest. Offer gate = the ratified peaceful-OR path, unchanged. `tend` is the one travel beat, so it is the one naming a landmark.
quests.title: The Makings

beats.description: Fill the waiting pot by Eloise's cottage door with whatever the hollow gives up.
Something that cannot thank you needs sitting with. The lamb pen in Riverfarm village.
Go back and sit Eloise's kettle. She has a question and then a first lesson.

resolution_paths.text: You filled her pot, sat with a lamb that could not thank you for it, and she taught you the first of the craft.
